ANSWER: NO
HALLUCINATIONS: None

All key financial terms in the memo are accurately supported by the source document:

- Amendment No. 3 to Credit Agreement, effective November 30, 2022, executed December 1, 2022 ✓
- Borrower: Baudax Bio, Inc. (Pennsylvania corporation) ✓
- Guarantors: Baudax Bio N.A. LLC (Delaware) and Baudax Bio Limited (Ireland) ✓
- Agent: Wilmington Trust, National Association ✓
- Lender: MAM Eagle Lender, LLC ✓
- Original credit agreement dated May 29, 2020 ✓
- Prior amendments dated August 1, 2022 and October 24, 2022 ✓
- Liquidity covenant requirements exactly as stated:
  - Oct 1 - Dec 6, 2022: $3,000,000 minimum ✓
  - Dec 7, 2022 - Feb 28, 2023: $4,500,000 minimum ✓
  - March 1, 2023 onwards: $4,000,000 minimum ✓
- Legal fees: Agent counsel $6,705.00 due December 1, 2022 ✓
- Legal fees: Lender counsel $42,813.58 due December 8, 2022 ✓
- Governing law: New York ✓

The memo appropriately indicates "N/A" for terms not specified in the amendment document (interest rate, maturity date, deal size, etc.), which is accurate since this is an amendment document rather than the original credit agreement.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS: 
- Original credit agreement date (May 29, 2020)
- Previous amendment dates (Amendment No. 1 and Waiver dated August 1, 2022; Amendment No. 2 dated October 24, 2022)
- Loan amount/facility size
- Interest rate terms
- Maturity date of the credit facility
- Security/collateral details beyond general mention
- Repayment terms and structure
